**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` defined in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-417`. `ExtractAll` parses the memo's raw `Content` with goldmark and walks the resulting AST once to derive the data, which is stored on the memo's `Payload.Tags` and `Payload.Property` fields (schema in `proto/store/memo.proto:7-29`, generated as `storepb.MemoPayload` / `storepb.MemoPayload_Property`).

**Triggers (call sites of `RebuildMemoPayload`):**
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, run on every new memo before it's persisted.
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, but only when the update mask includes the `content` path (i.e., only when the memo's text actually changes; other field updates like visibility/pinned don't recompute it).
- Bulk/background rebuild: `Runner.RunOnce()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` iterates all memos in batches and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each — a maintenance/backfill path (not currently wired into any automatic scheduler or CLI entrypoint found in this codebase, so it's invoked as a standalone runner).

**Extracted properties** (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:362-411`, `ExtractedData`/`MemoPayload_Property`):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` nodes found in content.
- `Mentions` — `@username` mentions (lowercased), collected in the same pass but not persisted onto `Payload` by `RebuildMemoPayload` (only `Tags`/`Property` are assigned back — `runner.go:85-86`).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block-level child if it's an H1 heading.
- `Property.HasLink` — true if any Markdown link node exists.
- `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span exists.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox exists.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked.

## Summary

This is the `usememos/memos` Go backend. Memo "derived metadata" (tags, title, boolean content-properties, and a preview snippet) is computed from markdown content via a dedicated markdown service, and the recomputation is invoked explicitly at the API/service layer on create and on content-updates — there is no DB trigger and no automatic recompute on every field update.

### 1. Memo model/schema

- `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` (lines 35-55) — the store-layer `Memo` struct has a `Content string` and `Payload *storepb.MemoPayload` field (no separate columns for title/tags/snippet — they live inside `Payload` or are computed on the fly).
- `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` (lines 7-27) — schema for `MemoPayload`:
```protobuf
message MemoPayload {
  Property property = 1;
  Location location = 2;
  repeated string tags = 3;

  message Property {
    bool has_link = 1;
    bool has_task_list = 2;
    bool has_code = 3;
    bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
    // The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present.
    string title = 5;
  }
  ...
}
```
So `Payload.Tags` and `Payload.Property.{HasLink, HasTaskList, HasCode, HasIncompleteTasks, Title}` are the persisted derived fields. Note: `Snippet` is NOT persisted — it's computed on-the-fly at read time (see below).

### 2. The computation functions

- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` — the `markdown.Service` interface (lines 27-55) defines the extraction API: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `GenerateSnippet`, etc.
  - `ExtractAll` (lines 355-422) — parses the markdown AST once and derives, in a single pass:
    - `Tags` — from `#tag` AST nodes (skipping tags inside links/images)
    - `Mentions` — from `@username` AST nodes (lowercased)
    - `Property.Title` — text of the first H1 heading if it's the very first block in the document
    - `Property.HasLink`, `Property.HasCode` (code block/fenced/span), `Property.HasTaskList`, `Property.HasIncompleteTasks`
  - `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int)` (lines 263-346) — walks the AST, concatenates block/inline text (skipping code blocks, converting `#tag` nodes back to `#tag` text and autolinks to their URL), then truncates at a word boundary and appends `" ..."` if truncated.
  - No word-count or reading-time field exists anywhere in this codebase.

- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (lines 74-88) — the glue function that actually mutates a `store.Memo`'s payload:
```go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	// Use goldmark service to extract all metadata in a single pass (more efficient)
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	if err != nil {
		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
	}
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```
  This same file also defines a `Runner` type with `RunOnce`/batch-rebuild logic (lines 14-72) intended to backfill/rebuild payloads for all memos in batches of 100 — but note this `Runner`/`RunOnce` is **not wired up anywhere** in `server/server.go` or elsewhere in the codebase (only `s3presign.NewRunner` is started as a background runner there). So it currently appears to be dead/unused code — only the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function is actually called.

- The **snippet** is computed separately and NOT stored — `getMemoContentSnippet` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 83-89):
```go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
	snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
	...
}
```

### 3. Where it's called (trigger points)

- **CreateMemo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, inside `CreateMemo` (line 70), immediately after building the new `store.Memo` and before `s.Store.CreateMemo(...)`:
```go
if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
    return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
}
```
  So tags/title/properties are computed once at creation time and persisted.

- **UpdateMemo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:435-451`, inside the `for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths` loop, **only when `path == "content"`**:
```go
if path == "content" {
    ...
    memo.Content = request.Memo.Content
    if err := memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService); err != nil {
        return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to rebuild memo payload: %v", err)
    }
    update.Content = &memo.Content
    update.Payload = memo.Payload
}
```
  So the payload (tags/title/properties) is recomputed and persisted only if the update request's field mask includes `content`. Updating other fields (visibility, pinned, state, etc.) does not trigger recomputation.

- **Snippet, at read/convert time** — computed fresh on every read, not persisted:
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` — inside `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators`, called whenever a `store.Memo` is converted to the API `v1pb.Memo` response (used by Get/List/Create/Update memo responses).
  - Also called for memo relations (`memo_service_converter.go:225,248`), memo comment/mention notifications (`user_service_notifications.go:318-391`), and memo relation service (`memo_relation_service.go:154-173`).

- **Mentions** (a related but separate derived value, used to notify users, not stored on the memo record) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `resolveMentionTargets` also calls `s.MarkdownService.ExtractAll` on memo content to find `@mentions` and dispatch notifications; this is invoked from the create/update memo mention-dispatch flow (`dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort`), independent of `RebuildMemoPayload`.

### Properties extracted, precisely

| Field | Persisted? | Where computed | Trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Payload.Tags` (`[]string`, from `#tag`) | Yes, in `MemoPayload.tags` | `markdown.ExtractAll` → `RebuildMemoPayload` | CreateMemo; UpdateMemo when `content` in update mask |
| `Payload.Property.Title` (first H1 heading text) | Yes | same | same |
| `Payload.Property.HasLink` | Yes | same | same |
| `Payload.Property.HasCode` | Yes | same | same |
| `Payload.Property.HasTaskList` / `HasIncompleteTasks` | Yes | same | same |
| `Snippet` (plain-text excerpt, max 64 chars, word-boundary truncated + `...`) | No — computed on demand | `markdown.GenerateSnippet` via `getMemoContentSnippet` | every read/convert to API response (List/Get/Create/Update, relations, notifications) |
| Mentions (`@user`) | No (not stored on memo) | `markdown.ExtractAll` via `resolveMentionTargets` | create/update, to resolve notification targets |
| Word count / reading time | Not implemented anywhere in this codebase | — | — |</result>

My exploration agent's findings confirm my answer and surface one addition worth noting: the question mentions "previews" specifically, and there's a preview-snippet computation I didn't include.

**Addendum:** Besides `Payload.Tags`/`Payload.Property` (computed in `RebuildMemoPayload`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`), memos also get a **content snippet** for previews — but it's computed on-the-fly at read time, not persisted:

- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int)` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:263-346` walks the markdown AST, concatenates text (skipping code blocks, resolving `#tag`/autolink nodes to plain text), and truncates at a word boundary (appending `" ..."` if cut).
- Called via `getMemoContentSnippet` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`, and invoked from `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` in `memo_service_converter.go:76-80` — i.e., **every time a memo is converted to its API response** (Get/List/Create/Update, memo relations, notifications), not just on create/update.

So there are two distinct derived-metadata computations:
1. **Persisted** (`Tags`, `Property.{Title,HasLink,HasCode,HasTaskList,HasIncompleteTasks}`) — recomputed only on `CreateMemo` and on `UpdateMemo` when the update mask includes `content`.
2. **Ephemeral preview snippet** — recomputed on every read/serialization, never stored.

Also worth flagging: `Runner.RunOnce` (the batch-rebuild-all-memos job in the same `runner.go` file) isn't wired into server startup anywhere in the current codebase — it looks like unused/dead code, so the only real triggers are the two call sites in `memo_service.go` (create and content-update).
